provenance.asset_description: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-10: Shattered Blades: The background art is of Zarta Dralneenm dressed in a smart red jacket, as she moves pieces around a battle map while her wayfinder illuminates the scene, with Pathfinders and Andoren soldiers moving in the background of a busy war camp.
